items.title: A scheme locally of finite type over a field is Jacobson with algebraic residue fields at closed points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a scheme X locally of finite type over a field k, the lemma states that the residue field at every closed point is algebraic over k and that X is a Jacobson scheme (statement lines 2669-2679). The proof first observes that both properties are local on X, so that one may assume X affine, and there the result is a consequence of the Hilbert Nullstellensatz; the author adds that it also follows from the general theory of Jacobson schemes developed in the morphisms chapter (proof lines 2681-2692). The claim is H2: a short locality reduction plus one classical input, with the alternative second proof reproduced as written and both routes stated without any step referred to the reader.
